searchText: Hey <@!291925846556540928> are NOISE handshakes something we must support by default? we want to restart our testnet ASAP but theres a bug in libp2p-noise we are still investigating. would it be possible to enable it in-flight once the testnet is running? The way libp2p protocols work is that you should be able to upgrade in-flight without any issue Main problem will be that other clients wont support an alternative so if they join the net, they'll fail to connect to any non-noise supporting node The infliggt upgrade of a libp2p protocol might be interesting to test anyway... So the upgraded nodes would support noise and the original protocol with a priority with noise. That way new nodes would choose to speak noise and new nodes talking to old nodes would fallback to the original protocl And by original protocol, Im assuming secio. That correct? So to be clear, for prysm to be an effective testnet for other clients to test against, you'll need the majority of nodes to upgrade and support noise. Otherwise, these external clients will have trouble finding nodes they can speak with correct Sounds good, good to know that we should be able to upgrade in-flight as long as the fallback works

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
The way libp2p protocols work is that you should be able to upgrade in-flight without any issue

Main problem will be that other clients wont support an alternative so if they join the net, they'll fail to connect to any non-noise supporting node
